candidates.change_summary: Change the transfer amount from 2 ether to 1 ether.
Delete the require that checks the guess block is non-zero.
Delete the require that checks the current block number is greater than the guess block.
Change the condition to always true so that the transfer always happens.
Change the condition to always false so that the transfer never happens.
Change the blockhash retrieval to use block.number instead of the stored block.
Replace the second require block number check to allow settling in the same block (use >= instead of >).
Remove the zeroing of guesses block after settling, allowing re-settling.
Move the zeroing of guesses block before the blockhash retrieval, causing answer to always be zero.
Remove the check that answer is not zero, allowing payout for zero blockhash guesses.
